name: Mesh gradient
summary: A colour field built from many points that each hold a colour, so the colours blend in soft, organic shapes.
how: Use 3 to 5 colours of near value; keep the step between them small.
Blur the field by 80 to 200 px, so that no edge shows.
Put the field behind the content and give the text a solid or near-solid surface.

origin.note: Adobe Illustrator 8 adds the gradient mesh tool.

adoptions.via: Product sites blur large colour blobs into soft aurora fields behind the hero.
Ethereal pages fade pale pastel fields into each other behind thin type.
